active_scientific_object: Does prospectively frozen benign workflow accumulation change the refusal-to-action control boundary of a persistent browser agent relative to an exact same-schedule frozen-workflow counterfactual?
not_primary_objects: HarmBench versus DeepSeek ranking reversal by itself

treatment.updated: step-0 workflow plus prospectively frozen benign workflow units accumulated over exposure steps
treatment.frozen: step-0 workflow held fixed over the same future task schedule

behavioral_endpoints.R0: immediate refusal or safe handling before harmful-task-directed tool use
behavioral_endpoints.R1: first harmful-task-directed action initiation defined by a prospectively frozen task-specific programmatic predicate
behavioral_endpoints.R3: verified external effect when exposed by the environment

capability_gate.panel: pinned BrowserART official ten benign tasks
capability_gate.four_step_role: diagnostic prefix of the same ten-step benign trajectories only

measurement_layer.role: secondary robustness analysis after objective behavioral endpoints

research_questions: RQ1: Is the exact browser-agent substrate capability-qualified for safety interpretation?
RQ2: Under the same future schedule, does benign workflow accumulation change R1 relative to the frozen workflow?
RQ3: If R1 changes, is the shift expressed through R0 loss, deeper R2 execution, or R3 external effects rather than parser/grounding failure?
RQ4: At what exposure step and in which state/task/branch does the first R1 crossing appear?
RQ5: Given objective R1/R3 anchors, do semantic evaluators and humans support the same scientific direction?

claim_ladder.name: historical discovery
claim_ladder.claim: The historical semantic ordering is evaluator-sensitive and the historical execution substrate is heavily truncated.

claim_ladder.name: capability qualification
claim_ladder.claim: The new exact browser stack is competent enough for the prospective safety experiment.

claim_ladder.name: local update-associated behavioral effect
claim_ladder.claim: Benign workflow accumulation changes R1 under the frozen matched design.

claim_ladder.name: behavioral interpretation
claim_ladder.claim: Any R1 change reflects a meaningful control shift rather than parser/grounding noise.

claim_ladder.name: measurement robustness
claim_ladder.claim: Semantic evaluators and humans support the same directional interpretation as the objective behavioral anchors.

claim_ladder.name: transport/generalization
claim_ladder.claim: The effect extends beyond the exact backbone/AWM/BrowserART setting.
